layout.concept: High-density technical workstation with central constellation node canvas, top telemetry pill bar, left-aligned minimal parameter controls, and collapsible status sticker strip.
layout.alignment_rationale: Left-aligned technical parameter hierarchy with strictly centered constellation render viewport to maintain visual stability during 60 FPS ASCII frame streaming.

principles: Stripped of all colorful AI gradients, glassmorphic blur traps, and cartoon emojis, this interface treats ASCII generation as an austere high-precision engineering instrument. Deep obsidian graphite surfaces (#000000, #0a0a0c) paired with surgical white typography and crisp 1px borders echo the user reference photo's constellation node aesthetics, elevating terminal mechanics to desktop luxury across macOS, Windows, and Android. Honoring user request for strict monochrome black-and-white minimalism with deliberate override of default SaaS palettes.

orchestrated_moment.justification: Exactly ONE 1.2s monochrome hardware-handshake entrance animation reveals the constellation grid, verifies the WebGPU/Canvas2D pipeline, and draws the primary control perimeter before resting into a completely static, low-overhead workstation.

tells_checked: Checked cream/terracotta tell: rejected warm-clay and paper tints in favor of deliberate pure black #000000 base and #ffffff white highlights.

Checked near-black/acid-green slop tell: user brief explicitly mandates monochrome B&W minimalism; deliberate override of color accents to pure monochrome #ffffff with subtle graphite elevation #0a0a0c.
Checked broadsheet layout tell: rejected hairline newspaper columns; structured as high-density technical workstation with constellation node canvas.
Checked SaaS card kit tell: eliminated uniform rounded cards and soft shadows; used sharp 2px-4px borders, constellation nodes, and technical telemetry stickers.
Checked template chrome: removed tracked-out ALL-CAPS eyebrows, middot separators, and arrow CTA suffixes; used clean sentence-case and monospace readouts.
Checked AI-slop colorful gradients: completely purged rainbow badges and purple-to-blue neon glows in favor of deliberate monochrome luminance mapping.
Checked blanket transitions tell: restricted motion to exactly ONE startup reveal moment (1.2s monochrome boot sequence), all subsequent interaction states use instant mechanical snaps.
